title: Parijatham
desc: Surendhar's mother tells him that she has found him a bride. Before the couple can meet, his mother dies in an accident. He sets out to find the woman his mother wanted him to marry.

title: Udan Pirappu
desc: Best friends Sathya and Viji are against selling their colony to a land grabber. Their friendship is put to the test after Viji falls in love with Sumathi and marries her.

title: Bramma
desc: Ravivarman, a sketch artist, loses his beloved wife in a tragic flight accident. When he helps the police track a dangerous criminal, the miscreant vows to seek revenge on Ravivarman.

title: Kuppathu Raja
desc: Rocket, a slum dweller, sees his life change when he joins forces with a gang leader MG Rajendran to put a stop to crime in their area.
